title: SEO tradicional vs. SEO com IA: o que você realmente precisa saber.
summary: O SEO tradicional otimiza para mecanismos de busca como o Google. O SEO com IA otimiza para plataformas de IA e recursos de pesquisa.
body_markdown:
[Ana Camarena](https://pt.semrush.com/blog/user/203815873/)


Ana Camarena leads Semrush’s Organic Content team. At Semrush, she helps scale blog production while maintaining quality, driving significant content growth. With 10+ years of experience in SEO and content marketing, she has developed content strategies for SaaS and e-commerce brands with an international scope. Ana has taught classes at EDEM Business School, Warwick University, and IEM Digital Business School. She holds a BA in Journalism and a Master’s in Digital Business & Innovation.
